title: SEC EDGAR XBRL Fact Value
description: Schema for a single XBRL fact value as returned in companyfacts and companyconcept endpoint responses

start.description: Period start date for duration concepts (e.g., income statement items). Absent for instant/point-in-time concepts.

end.description: Period end date for duration concepts, or instant date for balance sheet concepts.

val.description: The reported value. Typically a number for financial concepts, but may be a string for non-numeric concepts.

accn.description: Accession number of the EDGAR filing that reported this value.

fy.description: Fiscal year associated with this fact.

form.description: Form type of the filing reporting this value.

filed.description: Date the filing was accepted by EDGAR.

frame.description: Calendar period frame reference for use with the /api/xbrl/frames/ endpoint. Present only when the value aligns to a standard calendar period.
